note: the real GeForce Now session WITH the complete burst saved. The single gfn-before/gfn-after pair is one frame looked at twice; the burst is every frame's colour on both sides of the pass plus the motion field sent with each one. Run it with /opt/neuralscreen/run_manually.sh from a terminal in the graphical session and click the portal dialog. The deliverable is the burst directory (frames/, motion/, manifest.json) plus the 'capture split: wait ... read ...' line, quoted with the resolution. Downstream runs open it with tools/read_burst.py; the layout is docs/burst-format.md. Artifact copying now takes a directory as well as a file.
